source_class: user physical measurements of the four marked inner rear display posts

thread.authority: Existing B2 physical lock, corroborated by user measurement handoff

coplanarity.authority: Existing B2 lock and user measurement handoff

z_datum.cross_check_with_prior_C_measurement: PASS: prior C=10.0 mm was measured from front glass to the maximum rear feature; user confirms that measurement was from the front glass, and H=5 mm above the Z=5 mm rear PCB plane independently yields Z=10 mm post tops.

mainboard_direct_mount_implication.orientation: mainboard parallel to display rear PCB
mainboard_direct_mount_implication.component_policy: Prefer no tall components on the display-facing side. Place primary components on the rear/outward side. Any display-facing exception, especially the host DSI receptacle, requires local collision and FFC bend validation.

remaining_hard_gates: verify screw-head/washer geometry and mainboard hole diameter
verify added mainboard mass and screw preload are acceptable for the display assembly
map local display-side obstructions within the 5 mm inter-board gap
validate the 60 x 15 mm Type-B FFC U-bend at the selected host-receptacle location
do_not_infer: Thread confirmation is physical evidence from the lock/handoff, not inferred from the rear reference image.
The 5 mm inter-board gap is a plane-to-plane value, not a universal component-height clearance.
Do not freeze the mainboard outline until connector wall placement and local obstruction checks are complete.
